title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1984-04-26
lineage: Sony TCD5M (original record deck - Dolby on) > Pre Sonus Inspire GT > Sound Forge > .wav files > Trader's Little Helper > flac and ffp files
source: source: 2 Sennheiser 441's & 1 Beyer M160 microphones (15th row) > Nak MX100 w/2001 > Sony TCD5M (Dolby on)- analog master cassettes;

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a high‑energy show with standout Shakedown Street and Scarlet > Fire, though the band sounded a bit tired.
ai_review.review: The tape, sourced from DaWeez/D5 Scott’s audience work (and possibly a matrix mix), delivers crystal‑clear crowd ambience and brings out the fire in the opening Shakedown Street and Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain. While some listeners felt the band was a little fatigued that night, others described the performance as “thoroughly ripped,” making it an overall compelling listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for energy and standout openers but noted as slightly tired; recording quality is highlighted as among the best audience tapes, leading to a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call it a top‑notch audience capture (DaWeez/D5 Scott), noting crisp detail and great mix; some mention matrix contributors, but no significant flaws reported.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Openers are highlighted as exceptional, giving the show strong momentum; overall performance is energetic despite a hint of fatigue.
